regions.name: Mekong
regions.quote: Occurs throughout the Mekong river system in Laos, Thailand, and Cambodia, the Chao Phraya and Maeklong drainages in central and western Thailand, and some smaller watersheds in Peninsular Malaysia, but has not yet been recorded from peninsular Thailand.
